fixLanes.name: lane-1-governance-integrity
fixLanes.plan: Order: schema, API, MCP parity, UI, docs. Run one pytest + tsc + vite build sweep at the join, with no inline test loops. (1) One alembic revision after m5f9c3e7a2b4: proposals.proposer_member_id (GUID FK members.id, nullable, indexed), backfilled where lower(members.display_name)=lower(proposals.proposer) matches exactly one member in the same ecosystem; domains.name (String 200, nullable), backfilled from the purpose's leading segment before ' — ' when 120 chars or fewer. Mirror both in db/models/proposal.py:51 and domain.py:41. (2) proposals.py: add _caller_member(session,user_id,eco_id) and _can_manage(caller,p) = caller and (caller.id==p.proposer_member_id or ROLE_RANK.get(caller.role,0)>=ROLE_RANK['mod']). A NULL proposer_member_id means steward-only, mirroring discover.py:487-491. transition_status (541-603) and update_proposal (459-538) return 403 'Only the proposer or an ecosystem steward can change this proposal' when the check fails. create_proposal (379-456) sets proposer_member_id from the caller's member in create_req.ecosystem_id and defaults the proposer text to that member's display_name. get_proposal (364-375) and the transition payload (630-642) add caller_can_manage, caller_is_proposer and proposer_member_id; keep caller_can_conduct for participation and rewrite the comment at 364-365. submit_advice (678-761) returns 400 'Advice text is required' when content.strip() is empty and 409 'The proposer gathers advice and cannot advise their own proposal' when the caller is the proposer; the advisor comes from the caller's member display_name (AdviceEntryCreateRequest.advisor becomes optional and ignored). (3) mcp_server.py: create_proposal (~588-647) sets proposer_member_id; record_proposal_advice (651-688) refuses self-advice; transition_proposal (791-830) applies _can_manage to withdraw and draft->advice. (4) domains.py: serializers (64-114) add name and display_name (name -> purpose prefix -> domain_id). The list adds caller_is_participant with one IN query over the caller's member ids. get_domain (171-198) adds caller_is_participant, caller_is_steward (steward_id == caller member), caller_can_edit (steward or mod+), and participants [{member_id, display_name}] with participant_count. create_domain (201-259) requires await require_ecosystem_role(request, create_req.ecosystem_id, 'mod') and accepts name. update_domain (262-313) returns 403 unless the caller is steward or mod+, and accepts name. Update schemas/domains.py to match. (5) UI. ProposalDetail.tsx: replace the Change Status Select (653-671) with labelled buttons from proposal-vocab ('Open for advice' on draft; 'Withdraw proposal...' through the existing AlertDialog at 676-695), shown only when caller_can_manage. Toast 'Status changed to Advice: members can now give advice' and keep focus on the status region. Gate Edit (654-659) on caller_can_manage. AdviceTab (131-183): an empty submit sets an inline error (id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, aria-required) and focuses the textarea; on success read result.auto_transitions and, when it includes 'advice->consent', toast 'Advice submitted. The advice round is complete, so the proposal moved to Consent'. When caller_is_proposer, replace the advice form and the 'Your input is needed' banner (701-714) with 'You are the proposer: advice from others appears here'. Not-found copy (574-583): 'This proposal doesn't exist or belongs to an ecosystem you haven't joined' plus a /discover link. ProposalForm.tsx: give the SelectTriggers ids 'type', 'decision_type' and 'urgency' (168,183,211); prefill proposer with member.display_name on create (still editable); render proposer read-only in edit, since PUT ignores it. DomainDetail.tsx: h1 (195) shows display_name with the code as secondary text; drive the Join button from the server flags ('You participate in this domain', 'You steward this domain') and drop the local joined state (75); after joining, focus the status text; gate Edit (219-221) on caller_can_edit; add a participants card; render Domain Elements (257) as key/value rows. DomainList.tsx (75-77): heading and aria-label use display_name. DomainForm.tsx: add a Name field. SharesNeedsForm.tsx:248: option label is display_name (code secondary); :89 navigates to '/discover?tab=shares-needs'. DiscoverHub.tsx:189: initial tab from ?tab= (fallback ecosystems), kept in sync with the URL. FilterBar.tsx: SelectTrigger aria-label={f.label}. Add the new fields to types/api.ts, api-client.ts and use-governance.ts (submitAdvice returns auto_transitions). (6) Docs: api/AGENTS.md sections 'Proposal authorship and manage rule' and 'Domain naming and participation flags'; pages/governance/AGENTS.md for the caller_* flags. Lane 2 sends its api/AGENTS.md notes through the coordinator. Flow tests (end sweep only): non-author withdraw -> 403, author and mod -> 200; blank advice -> 400; self-advice -> 409; join then GET detail shows caller_is_participant=true; townhall domain create -> 403, mod -> 201.
